reason: The positive training coefficient survives my checks: adding productivity_2020 gives 0.80 (SE 0.24), the full set of pre-period controls gives 0.84 (SE 0.24), and the untrimmed model gives 0.86 (SE 0.24). The report's 0.95 comes from trimming on the outcome and leaving out pre-period productivity. That inflates the estimate slightly but doesn't change the sign or significance, and the causal wording should carry an observational-data caveat.
